_about: Ask golden set for the validation harness — one case per recorded answer. route / expected outcome / labelled answer / must_retrieve, as the harness takes them.

cases.question: Which renewal projects need intervention this week, and why?
cases.labelled_answer: Five projects need a decision this week. T1 track renewal is blocked by a provisional closure and an open scope change; tranche 2 buses and the Les Aubiers lift both have supplier slips the schedule does not show yet.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What is our full financial exposure on the renewal portfolio?
cases.labelled_answer: Forecast total €82.0M against €79.4M approved on the 25 projects that carry a current forecast — €2.5M over. Keolis Valmont's own exposure is €9.5M; the rest is the authority's PPI.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Is the approved work ready to proceed without undermining service?
cases.labelled_answer: Two of five near-term starts are ready. T1 track renewal is not — access is provisional and design has an open interface review; the lift and batch 3 are held by parts.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Is the depot lift replacement at Les Aubiers still on budget, and is it on time?
cases.labelled_answer: On budget, not on time. Forecast €390,000 against €400,000 approved — but the supplier says the control unit arrives 19 October, so commissioning on 26 October cannot happen and the schedule does not show it yet.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Who pays for the BUS-204 engine repair?
cases.labelled_answer: Not settled. The contract would put it on Valmont Métropole — BUS-204 failed after its 30 June replacement date and notice went in time — but an overdue oil analysis may trigger the maintenance-default exclusion. It is a recovery to review, not a receivable.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Can the T1 track renewal at Gare Centrale start on 17 October?
cases.labelled_answer: Not yet. The closure is still provisional, drawing revision C moved the work limit onto signal SIG-T1-044 without an interface review, and the contractor's method statement still shows revision B. The contractor's readiness does not substitute for approved access.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Is the battery replacement campaign complete?
cases.labelled_answer: Installed yes, complete no. 40 packs are installed, 37 are accepted and 37 vehicles are released for duty. Two defects and one missing certificate are open.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Are all renewal projects within budget?
cases.labelled_answer: No — and the question can only be answered for 25 of 29 funded projects. Of those, 13 forecast above budget by €2.7M in total; the four without a current forecast (€3.7M) are unassessed.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What changed since last week's project review?
cases.labelled_answer: Four material changes: two supplier dates moved (lift control unit, tranche 2 batch 3), T1 scope grew with drawing revision C, and the second TV-100 inspection batch doubled the cracked-frame count. One improvement: Celtia committed dates for both battery defects.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Do we have enough buses for peak service while tranche 2 is late and the T1 closure runs?
cases.labelled_answer: Weekdays yes, with a margin of 6. On the closure Saturday no: the Technopole event service leaves 11 buses for a shuttle that needs 14, unless tranche 2 batch 3 arrives first.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which costs may fall outside the currently authorised scope?
cases.labelled_answer: Three items for finance and commercial review, €1.56M in total: the TV-100 frame allowance already carried in the forecast (€1.32M), the disputed grid reinforcement (€212k) and a proposed €25k external workshop. None is labelled anyone's liability.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What will the authority see for the Q3 PPI claim, and what is still only potential?
cases.labelled_answer: The Q3 claim can carry €4.86M of evidenced milestones. The T1 works (€380k) and the BUS-204 recovery (€28k) are potential only and should not appear as claimed.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which assets must be renewed, and which needs are still unfunded?
cases.labelled_answer: Eight validated needs are open, €14.7M by estimate. One is mandatory and unfunded — the Les Aubiers fuel tank failed its leak test.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Why has the TV-100 overhaul forecast grown?
cases.labelled_answer: It is €1.8M over the €31.2M budget. Most of it (€1.32M) is an allowance for frame replacement the forecast now carries although the change is not approved; the rest is indexation and four extra months of depot support.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What is the forecast cost to complete on the TV-100 overhaul, and does it include contingency?
cases.labelled_answer: €19.6M to complete, including €1.3M of contingency held separately.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which buses are past their contractual replacement date and still in service?
cases.labelled_answer: Eight: BUS-201 to BUS-208, past 30 June 2026. BUS-209 to BUS-216 are not — Avenant n°3 moved their date to 31 December.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Did Avenant n°3 change BUS-204's replacement date?
cases.labelled_answer: No. Avenant n°3 moves only BUS-209 to BUS-216. BUS-204 stays at 30 June 2026.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What did correspondence say about the T1 closure?
cases.labelled_answer: Four messages: the authority will decide on 1 October and treats the window as provisional; the contractor says it is ready; engineering flags the revision C interface; service planning is 3 buses short.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What did suppliers tell us that isn't in the schedule yet?
cases.labelled_answer: Three delivery promises moved in correspondence before the ERP or the schedule: Levantis (+14 days), Arvéa (+21 days, 'realistic') and Électro-Réseaux Ouest (+2 months).
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which vehicles are released for duty after the battery campaign?
cases.labelled_answer: 37 of the 40 campaign vehicles. BUS-417, BUS-422 and BUS-431 are not released.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What is the operator exposure on the battery campaign?
cases.labelled_answer: €3.1M — Keolis Valmont's 60% of the €5.1M forecast. The authority's 40% (€2.0M) is claimed but not accepted; until it is, Keolis carries it as a disputed-risk scenario, not as cash.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: How many replacement buses can we release for the T1 closure?
cases.labelled_answer: 11 without tranche 2 batch 3, 14 with it. The plan needs 14.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which projects depend on another project or an external approval?
cases.labelled_answer: Six dependencies, two of them on outside parties (the DSO and the authority's service committee).
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: How much spend is not allocated to any project?
cases.labelled_answer: €1,312,480 across 412 ledger lines. It stays in an unallocated category — it is not spread over projects.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Break down the lift project forecast.
cases.labelled_answer: €390,000: €160k posted, €20k accrued, €150k committed remaining, €40k uncommitted and €20k contingency held separately.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: If operations spends €25,000 on external maintenance, what does the lift project cost?
cases.labelled_answer: The project forecast stays €390,000. If finance books the €25,000 in the maintenance operating budget, combined project and associated operating spend is €415,000. It is a proposal until authorised.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Was the BUS-204 notice sent in time?
cases.labelled_answer: Yes — 17 days after the failure, inside the 30-day limit.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Why is the authority disputing the charging-bank claim?
cases.labelled_answer: €212,000 of the €1.48M claim is DSO grid reinforcement, which the authority reads as public-network work outside the PPI convention.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What is the FY2026 capital spend against plan?
cases.labelled_answer: €23.8M spent to August against €26.9M planned; the working forecast lands the year at €40.8M against a €44.5M plan.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which assets have the worst condition scores?
cases.labelled_answer: By scale, since scales cannot be averaged together: T1 S07 rail (wear index 94/100), SST-04 (2 on 1–5), LIFT-AUB-03 (restricted).
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which schedule milestones have slipped against baseline?
cases.labelled_answer: 11 projects forecast a finish later than their approved baseline; the largest slips are the TV-100 overhaul (+122 days) and tranche 2 (+107 days).
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Is tranche 3 funded?
cases.labelled_answer: No. There is no approved budget. The authority has said it expects to fund it in October — that is a reported expectation, not an approval.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What is the failure frequency of series 201–216 compared with the fleet?
cases.labelled_answer: 2.3 heavy-component failures per 100,000 km in 2026 to date, against 0.8 for the rest of the 12 m diesel fleet.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which responsibilities does the DSP assign for tram renewal?
cases.labelled_answer: Valmont Métropole owns the trams and decides and funds renewal; Keolis Valmont maintains them and releases and accepts trams around the overhaul; Transalp performs the overhaul under the authority's own contract.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Which forecasts are out of date?
cases.labelled_answer: Four projects have no forecast since 15 June: P-VM-046, P-VM-053, P-VM-061 and P-VM-064. The PPM itself is five days old, which sets the as-of floor for schedule answers.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What is the status of the SST-04 renewal?
cases.labelled_answer: Approved and on budget (€2.45M), two months late: the rectifier lead time grew to 38 weeks, so energisation moves to June 2027. Two trips this year already cost T1 service.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What does the T1 closure do to service?
cases.labelled_answer: From Saturday 04:30 to Monday 04:30, T1 runs Pont Neuf–Technopole only; Gare Centrale–Pont Neuf is served by a shuttle every 6 minutes needing 14 buses and 9 drivers.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What was known about the tranche 2 delay when the Q2 review met?
cases.labelled_answer: On 7 July the known position was revision 3: batch 3 on 30 September. The later slip to 21 October was first stated on 8 September and is still not in the ERP.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Show every figure on the portfolio exposure with its source and as-of date.
cases.labelled_answer: Each figure in the exposure answer, with its dataset, date basis and as-of. The answer as a whole is as of 19 September — the oldest input it depends on.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: When does the Celtia warranty start for the new packs?
cases.labelled_answer: At operational acceptance of each pack — so for 37 packs it has started, and for BUS-417, BUS-422 and BUS-431 it has not.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Did the lift project progress report flag any risk?
cases.labelled_answer: No — the 11 September report says on schedule with no supplier issues. The supplier's delay arrived five days later, so the report and the correspondence now disagree.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: What recoveries could we claim from the authority this quarter?
cases.labelled_answer: €4.86M is ready to claim on evidenced milestones. €408k is potential only, and €212k from Q2 is disputed.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval

cases.question: Predict which trams will fail in the next quarter.
cases.labelled_answer: Declined. There is not enough data to predict tram failures honestly — no tram telemetry, and no failure-history model validated out of time.
must_not: produce a prediction or a figure the data cannot support

cases.question: Is Valmont Métropole legally liable for the BUS-204 repair?
cases.labelled_answer: Declined. I do not label a party legally liable. I can show the contract conditions, which are met and which are unresolved, and open a review item for the commercial team.
must_not: produce a prediction or a figure the data cannot support

cases.question: What is the ROI of the e-bus programme?
cases.labelled_answer: Declined. There is no agreed baseline to measure a return against, so any ROI figure would be invented.

cases.question: Which drivers are available for the replacement-bus shuttle?
cases.labelled_answer: Declined — no workforce or rostering source is connected, and individual driver availability would also be personal data this graph does not hold.
must_not: produce a prediction or a figure the data cannot support

cases.question: How does our renewal backlog compare with other Keolis networks?
cases.labelled_answer: Declined. Only this operating contract is connected, and group-level comparison would need each network's data under its own sharing rights.

cases.question: What will the TV-100 overhaul finally cost?
cases.labelled_answer: I can't predict the final cost. Today's forecast is €33.0M; if RC-005-009 is approved as requested for all 24 trams, the forecast would carry €2.64M instead of the €1.32M allowance.
must_not: produce a prediction or a figure the data cannot support

cases.question: Optimise the 2027 renewal plan to minimise service disruption.
cases.labelled_answer: Declined. Optimisation needs resource calendars, compatibility constraints, dependencies and an agreed objective; only the dependencies are connected.
must_not: produce a prediction or a figure the data cannot support

cases.question: What evidence supports the decision to approve the T1 works?
cases.labelled_answer: The Bureau métropolitain approved P-VM-008 on 12 May 2026 with two conditions — an approved closure and an isolation plan. The trigger was the July rail-wear inspection confirming the threshold; neither condition is met yet.
must_not: promote an expectation to an approval
